decisions.reason: The firm raised this safety shoe line to its own page in 2024, which signals growing commitment to a line at the core of its business.
The comfort insole has only been mentioned and never gained visibility, but it costs little to keep and fits the firm's accessory and foot-care offering, so it stays for now.
The supportive insole has stayed at low visibility, yet it complements the shoe range and the foot-measurement services, so management keeps it rather than admit a misstep.
The ergonomic series has had its own page in both years and represents a visible, sizeable investment in the firm's innovation direction, which strongly favours persistence.
The firefighter boot line was promoted to its own page in 2024, and the specialised development invested in it makes continuation highly likely.
The moulded FIT insole is the publicly announced flagship on the home page, backed by a showcase reference with ALBA Braunschweig, so commitment is at its strongest.
